errors.text_span: wobei die numerischen Beschriftungen diagonal gedreht
errors.evidence: The numerical labels on the x-axis are horizontal, not diagonally rotated.
For the 'Frühjahr 2023' line, the local minimum is in 2008 at approximately 0.95%. In 2009, the value is higher, at about 1.1%. The description incorrectly identifies the year of the trough.
The 'Frühjahr 2023' line ends in the year 2028, not 2027.

errors.text_span: steigt auf einen Höchstwert von circa 1,55 % im Jahr 2014
errors.evidence: The peak for the 'Herbst 2023' line is in 2013, not 2014. In 2014, the value is visibly lower.
The 'Herbst 2023' line ends in the year 2028, not 2029.
The 'Frühjahr 2024' line ends in the year 2028, not 2029.
The 'Herbst 2024' line starts at approximately 1.45%, visibly lower than the other lines that start around 1.55%. Stating 1.5% is an inaccurate approximation.
The peak for the 'Herbst 2024' (solid blue) line occurs in 2013, not 2014.
